live_provider_acceptance.requirement: Real end-to-end provider generation and approval with user-provided test credentials for documented supported providers; no keys in repo.

email_integrations.requirement: Gmail OAuth and Microsoft Graph if advertised as v1-supported; otherwise explicitly remove from v1 scope and document supported IMAP/SMTP prerequisites.

isolated_code_execution.requirement: Sandboxed Claude Code/Codex execution if advertised as supported; otherwise explicitly exclude from v1 and preserve review-only guarantees.

production_security.requirement: Independent threat-model review, negative tenancy and approval tests, secret/dependency/history scans, and recorded resolution of findings.

recovery_and_retention.requirement: Rehearsed disaster restore including encryption key recovery, upgrade/rollback paths and documented retention/export/deletion policy.

cross_platform_install.requirement: Fresh Windows, macOS and Linux Docker install, upgrade and restart/persistence evidence, not just PowerShell syntax validation.

independent_benchmark.requirement: If any autonomy improvement claim is published: independently reviewed matched corpus and raw results, or explicitly state no comparative result exists.

public_release_checks.requirement: Complete clean clone and install; history-based secret scan; published tagged commit with green full CI, changelog, accurate limitations, release notes and licensing audit.
